objective: Test whether information arriving in QQQ and IWM during the first hour diffuses into SPY slowly enough to trade through UPRO or SPXU.

novelty_and_lineage.new_sensor: QQQ and IWM 30-minute bars are the primary directional sensors; prior UPRO/SPXU searches used SPY or the leveraged pair itself.
novelty_and_lineage.not_the_failed_market_intraday_momentum_: The failed canonical rule predicted each ETF's last half-hour from its own first half-hour. These candidates predict the broad S&P afternoon from cross-market agreement, sequential broadening, or a synthetic-index residual.
prohibited_repairs: change the two fixed 30-minute signal bars
select weekdays, years, directions, volatility states, or symbols

data.signal: Local Alpaca IEX SPY, QQQ, and IWM 30-minute regular-session bars
data.consolidated_execution_audit: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m where available

breadth_consensus.score: sign of QQQ 09:30-open to 10:29-close return, only when IWM has the identical nonzero sign
breadth_consensus.trade: UPRO for positive agreement, SPXU for negative agreement, otherwise cash
breadth_consensus.economic_claim: Agreement between growth leadership and small-cap breadth indicates a broad risk transfer that should persist into the S&P afternoon.

sequential_breadth_relay.score: sign of QQQ's first 30-minute return, only when IWM's second 30-minute return has the identical nonzero sign and IWM's second-bar absolute return exceeds its first-bar absolute return
sequential_breadth_relay.trade: UPRO for a positive relay, SPXU for a negative relay, otherwise cash
sequential_breadth_relay.economic_claim: Information first appears in the liquid growth complex, then broadens with increasing intensity into small caps. The temporal relay is stronger evidence than simultaneous direction.

synthetic_index_catchup.score: equal-weight mean of QQQ and IWM first-hour returns minus SPY's first-hour return
synthetic_index_catchup.trade: UPRO when the synthetic cross-market return is above SPY, SPXU when below, skip exact ties
synthetic_index_catchup.economic_claim: QQQ and IWM form a deliberately simple growth-plus-breadth synthetic market. A lagging SPY should converge toward that cross-market information during the afternoon.

evidence_warning: All historical years have been viewed by the broader research program. Frozen-rule partitions reduce but do not eliminate selection bias; a survivor still requires future paper validation.
